title: vaccinium langloisii
intro: Vaccinium langloisii, commonly known as Langlois' blueberry, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium langloisii include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
